title: Derived categories of module sheaves have direct sums
statement: For every scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] and every set-indexed family $(E_i)_{i\in I}$ in the derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, the termwise direct sum of any representative complexes represents a direct sum of the $E_i$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$. For every integer $q$, its cohomology sheaf is canonically isomorphic to $\bigoplus_{i\in I} H^q(E_i)$.

source.place: Lemma 07D9 (lemma-derived-products), clauses (1)-(2); the cohomology identity is in perfect.tex, proof of Lemma 08DT (lemma-quasi-coherence-direct-sums), from exactness of direct sums

proof.text: Apply the termwise localization coproduct theorem for the chosen representatives.
Apply the canonical cohomology direct-sum theorem in each integer degree.

lean.statement: theorem derivedAmbientDirectSums (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] (I : Type u) (E : I → schemeDerivedCategory X) (K : I → CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (e : ∀ i : I, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (K i) ≅ E i) : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (∐ K)) (fun i ↦ (e i).inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (Sigma.ι K i)))) ∧ ∀ q : ℤ, IsIso (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) q).map ((e i).inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (Sigma.ι K i))))
